title: Co-Branded Card Reduction on Summit Miles Upgrade Co-Pays
content:
Holders of the Crestline co-branded card pay a lower co-pay on a cleared Crestline Summit Loyalty Program miles upgrade. The card is shown by the companion certificate issued on a card anniversary, as its record under the Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes charter shows it.

- A Crestline Companion Certificate First or Premium Economy issued within the last 12 months takes 20 USD off.
- A Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin or Main Plus issued within the last 12 months takes 10 USD off.
- A member with no such certificate in that span takes nothing off.

"Within the last 12 months" means fewer than 12 whole calendar months from the certificate's issue date to the day the charge is made; a certificate issued on 9 November 2025 is inside the span on 8 November 2026 and outside it on 9 November 2026.

The reduction is taken off the co-pay to charge and never takes it below zero.

**Hypothetical figures.** A co-pay of 56.25 USD falls to 36.25 USD with a card-anniversary Crestline Companion Certificate First and to 46.25 USD with a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus. A co-pay of 15.00 USD with the First certificate falls to 0, not below.
